description: This file defines a layout component for a dynamic route segment in a Next.js application, which manages defects by ID. It includes a function to generate static parameters required for Next.js static export, handling dynamic URL segments, and a React functional component that renders its children.

methods.name: generateStaticParams
methods.description: An async function that returns an empty list of parameters to support static export of dynamic routes in Next.js.

methods.name: DefectIdLayout
methods.description: A React functional component that wraps its children within a fragment, used as a layout for dynamic defect ID pages.
